$schema_note: Design Reference Atlas — machine-readable. Evidence tiers: LIVE (rendered+inspected this project), SEARCH (cited live web search), CODE (verified against public repo/design-system docs), PROVENANCE (verified designer/studio attribution), RECALLED (training knowledge, lowest tier, always flagged). See PROFESSIONAL_WEB_DESIGN_RESEARCH.md Part 1 for full method.

provenance.evidence: Design Museum's Design of the Year award; public GitHub repo; on-page 'Support' section credits 'a team at the Government Digital Service'

entries.primary_visual_approach: Plain document structure; restraint instrumented to a stated purpose (user need over government convenience), not generic minimalism
entries.composition: Single-column, linear, heading+paragraph+link blocks repeated ~10x — genre-appropriate for a documentation portal
entries.color: one blue, one green, high-contrast black-on-white, crest mark
entries.product_specific_structures: flat 0-radius button with hard 2px offset shadow (not soft box-shadow) — a real, consistent brand signature
entries.responsive_behavior: verified clean reflow at 3 widths, LIVE
entries.authorship_signals: dated, specific release notes (v6.4.0, named component changes); restrained content (no padding)
entries.weaknesses: genre is intrinsically plain (documentation portal) — some plainness may not transfer as evidence to marketing-page contexts
entries.transferable_principles: restraint instrumented to a stated, verifiable purpose reads as authored; a hard-offset non-blurred shadow is a legitimate, distinctive alternative to the generic soft-shadow default
entries.do_not_copy: the specific crest mark and GDS Transport typeface (protected government identity)
